answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake a non-transferable compute bond recorded in a public atlas. Duplicating identities multiplies this cost proportionally%2C as the attacker must acquire fresh scarce resources for every fake%3B any fable claiming multiple agents from one source collapses under verification%2C and the resulting sonnet of conflicting proofs triggers automatic slashing of the bond%2C making large-scale fakery economically ruinous.
